newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks jump at open, curbs set.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks jump at open, curbs set.

text.p: The Dow industrials jumped more than 50 points at the start of trade Monday and the New York Stock Exchange set index-arbitrage trading curbs at 0933 EDT/1333 GMT.

After less than 10 minute of trade the Dow was up 79.47 at 6531.37. Advancers led decliners by a six-to-one margin. The Nasdaq composite index was up 8.65 at 1225.06 and advancers led decliners two to one.
The markets were boosted by lower-than-expected U.S. inflation data. The long bond was up 28/32 to yield 7.10.
